query.normalizedText:
select
	sum(l_extendedprice * l_discount) as revenue
from
	lineitem
where
	l_shipdate >= date $1
	and l_shipdate < date $2 + interval $3 year
	and l_discount between $4 - $5 and $6 + $7
	and l_quantity < $8
